name: setup-ovr-platform-util
description: A GitHub Action to setup the ovr-platform-util tool command alias.
author: RageAgainstThePixel

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run bundle
scripts.clean: npm install && shx rm -rf dist/ out/ node_modules/ && npm ci
scripts.test: shx rm -rf out/ && tsc --ignoreConfig src/version.spec.ts --outDir out --module node16 --target es2020 --moduleResolution node16 --types node && node --test out/version.spec.js
